title: Keto Irish Oat Bowl
description: A keto take on a traditional Irish oat bowl, made with low-carb ingredients and a delicious nutty flavor.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the Irish oats and heavy cream.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, or until the oats have absorbed most of the cream.
Stir in the sliced almonds, cinnamon, and vanilla extract.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Transfer the oat mixture to a bowl and top with a drizzle of steeped coffee.
